items.t: JP Morgan Maintains Neutral on Sarepta Therapeutics, Raises Price Target to $22
items.sum: JP Morgan analyst Anupam Rama maintains Sarepta Therapeutics (NASDAQ:SRPT) with a Neutral and raises the price target from $20 to $22.

items.t: At $215, Moderna Stock Already Prices In A Comeback
items.sum: Our Nov 16 piece, How Much Could Moderna Stock Give Back?, found that Moderna (MRNA) stock had returned 736.3% over the twelve months to Nov 13, against 11.7% for the S&P 500. The next question is the long one: where could the stock be in five years.
